meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 处理天文数据与物理量计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用Python做天文数据处理或模拟。
copy.tagline_en: Process astronomical data and physical quantities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with astronomical data or simulations in Python.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Astropy 库处理天文数据，包括单位换算、坐标转换、读取 FITS 文件、表格操作、时间计算、宇宙学距离计算和图像坐标变换。
howto.when: 当你需要编写或调试天文数据分析代码，涉及单位、坐标、FITS 文件、表格、时间、宇宙学或 WCS 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Astropy 把 100 秒差距换算成千米。
将 ICRS 坐标 (10.5°, 41.2°) 转换为银道坐标。
say.note: Claude 会使用 SkyCoord 进行坐标变换。

say.text: 用 Planck18 宇宙学模型计算红移 1.5 的光度距离。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Astropy library for astronomical data analysis, including unit conversions, coordinate transformations, FITS file I/O, table operations, time handling, cosmological calculations, and WCS transformations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to implement or debug astronomical data analysis code involving units, coordinates, FITS files, tables, time, cosmology, or WCS.

say_en.text: Convert 100 parsecs to kilometers using Astropy.
say_en.note: Claude will use astropy.units for unit conversion.

say_en.text: Transform ICRS coordinates (10.5°, 41.2°) to Galactic coordinates.
say_en.note: Claude will use SkyCoord for coordinate transformation.

say_en.text: Calculate the luminosity distance at redshift 1.5 using Planck18 cosmology.
say_en.note: Claude will call astropy.cosmology for the calculation.
